_about: Acetone (1) + methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa, binary data set without ionic liquid from Li et al. (2018). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of acetone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetone.

source.citation: W. Li, Y. Du, X. Chen, J. Li, S. Guo, T. Zhang, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium for acetone + methanol system containing different ionic liquids at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilibria 459 (2018) 10-17
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3 (boiling temperature) and 4 (vapour mole fraction): the binary acetone + methanol set without ionic liquid. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Ebulliometric (recirculating still) and chromatographic method according to the ThermoML record. Expanded uncertainties given in the record: T about 0.09-0.1 K, y_1 0.003-0.005. The ThermoML record carries no consistency-test result; validation/python/fit_parameters.py runs a point test (Van Ness / Fredenslund type) and prints it. Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files), both reads identical.
